about: Renders a paragraph in a body size, a text ink, a weight and an alignment.

align.about: The four alignments of a paragraph in a 576px room. `start` and `end` follow the writing direction.
align.title: Alignment

mask.about: The three fade masks. `bottom` fades the last lines, `edges` fades both inline ends of a line that scrolls, and `radial` fades out from the centre.
mask.title: Mask

motion.about: The animation a paragraph enters with. Each one runs once when the paragraph mounts.
motion.title: Motion

release: Payouts settle within two business days in 34 countries. A transfer started before 14:00 UTC arrives on the same day, and the dashboard shows the expected arrival date of every transfer.
session: Your session ends in five minutes.

size.about: The five steps of the body text role.
size.title: Sizes

title: Text

tone.about: Every text ink at every weight. The inverted ink is for a dark surface, so its row renders on `bg.inverted`.
tone.title: Inks and weights

truncate.about: A paragraph that wraps, and the same paragraph cut to one line with an ellipsis. Show the full text elsewhere, such as in a detail view.
truncate.title: Truncate
